card: Adopts the compact on-disk key scheme from txindex (#35531) for txospenderindex, reducing per-entry key size by approximately 33% (from 18 to 12 bytes). Replacing file-based disk positions with block sequence numbers also prepares txospenderindex to eventually support pruned mode. The change refactors shared block-sequencing helpers out of txindex, handles hash prefix collisions by filtering candidates against the active chain, and supports reading legacy index entries.
evidence: PR description: 'Each entry is about 33% smaller (key bytes): before: 's' (1) + SipHash-2-4 of the outpoint (8) + CDiskTxPos, as varints nFile (2) + nPos (4) + nTxOffset (3) = 18 bytes; after: 'x' (1) + SipHash-1-3-UJ prefix (5) + block sequence varint (3) + tx offset (3) = 12 bytes'
PR description: 'The motivation is to save space and to allow replicating what #36002 does for txindex, by referencing blocks instead of local files.'
problem: Each txospenderindex entry consumes roughly 18 bytes on disk using 8-byte SipHash-2-4 keys and raw disk file positions (CDiskTxPos), leading to larger disk usage and preventing the index from easily referencing blocks instead of local files (a prerequisite for pruned-mode support).

risk.why: Bugs in index migration, serialization, or active-chain filtering could cause gettxspendingprevout to return incorrect spending data or corrupt the spender index DB.

scope_notes: Extracts block sequence and locator utilities out of txindex into new files src/index/block_seq.{h,cpp} and src/index/base.{h,cpp} before updating txospenderindex.
summary: Adapts txospenderindex to use the compact on-disk key format introduced for txindex in PR #35531. Key entries are shortened by replacing raw disk transaction positions with block sequence numbers and a 5-byte salted hash prefix of the spent outpoint. Common block-sequence tracking and sync locator logic are factored out into shared index utilities.
